class.name: OcgToplocDatum3d
class.brief_description: Describes a coordinate transformation, i.e. a change to an elementary 3D coordinate system, or position in 3D space. A Datum3D is always described relative to the default datum. The default datum is described relative to itself: its origin is (0,0,0), and its axes are (1,0,0) (0,1,0) (0,0,1).

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a Datum3D form a Trsf from gp. An error is raised if the Trsf is not a rigid transformation.

method.name: Transformation
method.description: Returns a gp_Trsf which, when applied to this datum, produces the default datum.
